description: Installed-size budget for each direct production dependency. scripts/check-dependency-weight.mjs measures each package under node_modules on disk, so a dependency that balloons the install (or a heavy package added for one helper) is visible before it reaches the bundle.

budgets.name: recharts
budgets.reason: Charting stack with its d3 dependencies vendored. Already the largest install; a further jump needs a charting-budget conversation.

budgets.name: react-dom
budgets.reason: React renderer. Raises with a React major and should be reviewed with the upgrade.

budgets.name: @fontsource/geist-mono
budgets.reason: Bundled Geist Mono weights and subsets. Prefer trimming subsets over widening the budget.
